3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: My shoes echoed on stone as I walked down the palace corridor to Hugo's study.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: My uncle had invited me for a one-on-one talk. And though I had plenty on my mind, I could hardly decline.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Titus remained on guard outside as I pushed open the door and stepped inside.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I cast my eye over the filigreed mahogany desk, the antique cabinets and the tasteful paintings and sculptures lining the walls.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: A fire flickered in the fireplace. Two leather armchairs had been set out in front of it -- one empty, the other occupied by Hugo.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: My uncle rose and bowed upon my approach.

9.speaker: Hugo Toras
9.text: "Your Majesty. Thank you for joining me this evening."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Come off it, Hugo. It's just us two here. Talk to me as an equal."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Of course, Your Grace. When my Grand Vizier summons me, I have no choice but to obey."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I don't have much time. What do you want?"

13.speaker: Hugo Toras
13.text: "Of course the war deserves your full attention. I will make this brief."

17.speaker: Hugo Toras
17.text: "Of course you have a lot on your plate. I will make this brief."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "What's going on? Is there news about Vina?"

23.speaker: Hugo Toras
23.text: "I'm afraid not. We must trust that our brave men and women in uniform will bring her back home safely."

25.speaker: Hugo Toras
25.text: "Regardless, I know you have much business to attend to. So I appreciate you taking the time to come here."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: He beckoned me over, and we both sat.

33.speaker: Hugo Toras
33.text: "How much thought have you given to the future of House Toras?"

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "This family means everything to me. You should know that by now."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "It's the future of this kingdom that concerns me, not that of my house."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "A king's legacy should be determined by his words and deeds, not his lineage."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "What future? I aspire to make this country a place where noble names no longer carry any weight."

42.speaker: Hugo Toras
42.text: "The two futures are one and the same, Your Majesty."

43.speaker: Hugo Toras
43.text: "Our family's roots can be traced all the way back to the Rezenid Empire. We have survived war, conquest and numerous challenges to the throne to be where we are today."

45.speaker: Hugo Toras
45.text: "Whatever your aspirations, you cannot deny your heritage."

46.speaker: Hugo Toras
46.text: "But how will his words and deeds live on with no name to remember him by?"

50.speaker: Hugo Toras
50.text: "I brought you here to give you a warning. Certain members of our house have begun to speak ill of you."

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: He picked up a poker and jostled the logs in the fireplace. A shower of sparks flew upwards.

52.speaker: Hugo Toras
52.text: "You'll be happy to know that House Toras is quite pleased with your reign so far."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "'Certain members'. Are you one of them?"

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "My decisions were made with my country in mind. If that pisses off a few cousins, so be it."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "What do you mean? I've done nothing but try to earn their favor since I took the throne."

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: Bruno's nails clicked on stone as my dog followed me down the palace corridor to Hugo's study.

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: Bruno raced into the room as I pushed open the door. Titus remained on guard outside.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: Bruno was trying to jump up into my uncle's lap. Hugo sternly shooed the dog off and ordered him to lie at his feet.

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "I'll thank you to be nicer to Bruno."

72.speaker: Hugo Toras
72.text: "Dogs crave strict hierarchies, Your Majesty. They are happiest when they know who their master is."

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: He rose and bowed as I approached.

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "Surely they realize the extenuating circumstances I'm facing."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "They'd better be. I've done nothing but try to earn their favor since taking the throne."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "My decisions as king have been made with my country in mind. If my cousins like them too, that's just a bonus."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "Thank you for telling me that. It means a lot to know I have Valenqiris' support during these trying times."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "Then what's with the 'in danger of losing it all' talk?"

79.speaker: Hugo Toras
79.text: "'Extenuating circumstances' do not explain all of your policies."

80.speaker: Hugo Toras
80.text: "You've exploited our beloved Valenqiris for resources while failing to mitigate the environmental damage that resulted."

87.speaker: Hugo Toras
87.text: "Just as I warned, there has been a sizeable backlash against the anti-landowner tax you introduced."
87.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false)

88.speaker: Hugo Toras
88.text: "Your permissive attitude towards foreigners has left native Rizians questioning their place in the new order."
88.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

95.speaker: Hugo Toras
95.text: "I personally am worried about the steps you have taken to erode this country's Wruhecist foundations. And I am not the only one."
95.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

96.speaker: Hugo Toras
96.text: "The less said about your permissive attitude towards sexual deviancy, the better."

100.speaker: Hugo Toras
100.text: "I beg your pardon, but you cannot be serious about that."

101.speaker: Hugo Toras
101.text: "Our relations are unfortunately more than merely 'pissed off''."

102.speaker: Hugo Toras
102.text: "I myself would never say a word against you. But some of your decisions have admittedly vexed me."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I'm not going to apologize for anything."
104.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Watch your mouth, Uncle. Your statements are bordering on treasonous."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "I had no idea I had angered our house that much. Thank you for telling me."
109.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I can't even think about appeasing House Toras until we get Vina back."
110.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "I can't even think about appeasing House Toras until we win the war."
114.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

115.speaker: Hugo Toras
115.text: "I am not telling you this because I want an apology. My aim is to keep you in power."

116.speaker: Hugo Toras
116.text: "I wouldn't be a very effective advisor if I didn't tell you."

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "Treason is the last thing on my mind. I am trying to keep you in power."

118.speaker: Hugo Toras
118.text: "I would advise a different approach. If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support the rescue of your daughter."

119.speaker: Hugo Toras
119.text: "I would advise a different approach. If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support you on the battlefield."

123.speaker: Hugo Toras
123.text: "If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support you on the battlefield."

124.speaker: Hugo Toras
124.text: "I am loath to remind you, but there are those in House Toras who believe my brother, and hence you, should have been removed from the royal line of succession after introducing commoner blood."

125.speaker: Hugo Toras
125.text: "Your actions as king have unfortunately poured fuel on those flames."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "Then what do you suggest I do? I can't backtrack on my decisions."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "They're a bunch of crackpots. Nobody will listen to them."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Rizia has other royal houses. It's fine if I lose the support of one."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "What exactly are you implying? Are you calling my legitimacy as king into question?"

131.speaker: Hugo Toras
131.text: "Of course I respect your legitimacy, Your Majesty. I am simply repeating the claims of others."

132.speaker: Hugo Toras
132.text: "Some of those 'crackpots' wield extraordinary influence in Valenqiris and Rizia Imperii."

133.speaker: Hugo Toras
133.text: "But you can make wiser ones in the future."

134.speaker: Hugo Toras
134.text: "To lose House Toras is to lose Valenqiris and Rizia Imperii. In other words, half of our kingdom's population."

136.speaker: Hugo Toras
136.text: "But I will tell you this. If you permit Her Highness to marry this man, your grip on the throne will weaken to the point where I cannot recover it."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "They are in love. I can't deny them that."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "He'll give up his name if he marries her. Their children will still be Torases."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "He's not just the Sazon heir, he's the House of Delegates majority speaker. He could be a powerful ally."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "He's not just the Sazon heir, he's the House of Delegates opposition leader. Marrying him to Vina will help neutralize him."

147.speaker: Hugo Toras
147.text: "Or turn him into even more of a danger."

148.speaker: Hugo Toras
148.text: "You needn't allow your reign to be undone by a pair of starry-eyed youths. There are actions that can be taken."

149.speaker: Hugo Toras
149.text: "I am certain you had good intentions in allowing the Sazon heir to court Vina."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Let the chips fall where they may. I am not going to interfere in my daughter's love life."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "'Actions'. That sounds like a euphemism if I ever heard one."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "I've been good to his house. Perhaps I can convince him to back off."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "It won't be easy, but I can try to convince him to back off."

158.speaker: Hugo Toras
158.text: "As king, you can make use of the Golden Guard's expanded powers to implicate the boy in treason."

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Hugo replied without a trace of anger in his voice.

161.speaker: Hugo Toras
161.text: "By all means, then, allow the Sazon union to proceed."

165.speaker: Hugo Toras
165.text: "With Su Omina still on your side, it would not be difficult to arrange a covert assassination."
165.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] > 5  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 1)

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "No. I could never do that to Vina."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "What makes you think I'd even consider such a suggestion?"

171.speaker: Hugo Toras
171.text: "But if that doesn't work, you have other channels available to you."

173.speaker: Hugo Toras
173.text: "Once Vina makes it safely home from Pales, that is."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Tempting. What am I even king for, if not to get rid of my rivals?"

181.speaker: Hugo Toras
181.text: "He's an intelligent young man. Surely he can be persuaded to do right by this kingdom."
181.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_ActivitiesIncrease"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_ZilleIncidentResponse_DefendSO"] == true)

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "I see no need for action. Manus isn't a threat to me."

190.speaker: Hugo Toras
190.text: "I'll do my best to spin it as a positive for our house. But I cannot promise I will succeed."

191.speaker: Hugo Toras
191.text: "If that is your decision, I will respect it."

192.speaker: Hugo Toras
192.text: "But if you're going to allow Mr. Sazon to lurk in the background, it's even more imperative that Her Highness be wed as soon as possible."

194.speaker: Hugo Toras
194.text: "Apologies if I misunderstood, Your Majesty. I thought you expanded the Golden Guard with exactly this kind of eventuality in mind."

198.speaker: Hugo Toras
198.text: "Apologies if I misunderstood, Your Majesty. I thought you supported Su Omina with just this kind of eventuality in mind."

199.speaker: Hugo Toras
199.text: "I have not even mentioned our house's gravest concern."

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: He spoke the name like a curse word.

204.speaker: Hugo Toras
204.text: "Not only does the young radical now lead the House of Delegates..."

208.speaker: Hugo Toras
208.text: "I'm worried that he may still harbor intentions to wed your daughter."

212.speaker: Hugo Toras
212.text: "I'm worried that he may have designs on your daughter."

216.speaker: Hugo Toras
216.text: "The young radical's influence in the House of Delegates may have diminished, but I wouldn't underestimate his ability to sway people to his side."
216.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true)

218.speaker: Hugo Toras
218.text: "The young radical continues to put forth preposterous proposals in the House Of Delegates. And furthermore..."
218.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "Don't be ridiculous, Hugo. I wouldn't let Vina anywhere near him."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "As a matter of fact, he and Vina asked for my blessing."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "Dammit, Hugo, don't you have anything better to do than worry about my daughter's love life?"

227.speaker: Hugo Toras
227.text: "We have already established that whom the Princess marries affects us all."

228.speaker: Hugo Toras
228.text: "Even more so now that you have jeopardized your relationship with House Toras."

229.speaker: Hugo Toras
229.text: "I will assume you did not grant it."

230.speaker: Narrator
230.text: Hugo looked at me in astonishment.

231.speaker: Hugo Toras
231.text: "I am confident she will soon be returned from Pales safe and sound."

232.speaker: Hugo Toras
232.text: "When she does come back, who she marries will be of the utmost importance."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "With a heavy heart, I denied their love."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "I told them I'd give them my blessing once Vina returned from Pales. I was hoping to buy some time."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Forbid a young couple like that from seeing each other, and it'll just drive them closer together."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "You are supposed to be my advisor, Uncle. Not my interlocutor."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "Of course I didn't. I'm not an idiot."

244.speaker: Hugo Toras
244.text: "That isn't entirely within your control, though, is it?"

245.speaker: Hugo Toras
245.text: "You're right. I should speak to you as an adult."

246.speaker: Hugo Toras
246.text: "He's an ambitious young man. There must be something he wants more than the Princess."
246.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_ActivitiesIncrease"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_ZilleIncidentResponse_DefendSO"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] > 5  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] > 5  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 1) == false)

247.speaker: Hugo Toras
247.text: "And if the carrot doesn't work, there is always the stick."

248.speaker: Hugo Toras
248.text: "In the long run, it is kinder to break her heart than to doom her reign."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "Why do you think I sent her to Pales? It's been so long that she probably doesn't even think about him anymore."

254.speaker: Hugo Toras
254.text: "Still, if you want to completely make sure he will not be a problem... there are actions that can be taken."

256.speaker: Hugo Toras
256.text: "Think of Lyza the Great's single folly. Do not underestimate the allure of forbidden love."

257.speaker: Hugo Toras
257.text: "If you want to completely eliminate him as a threat... there are actions that can be taken."

261.speaker: Hugo Toras
261.text: "But if you're going to allow Mr. Sazon to lurk in the background, it's even more imperative that Her Highness be wed immediately after her return from Pales."

262.speaker: Hugo Toras
262.text: "All I am saying is that if you want to completely eliminate Mr. Sazon as a threat, there are actions that can be taken."

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "The last time you tried getting those two together, Bruno got shot."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "You saw what happened on our hunting trip. They don't get along at all."

272.speaker: Hugo Toras
272.text: "A political marriage is not about 'getting along'. You of all people should know that."

273.speaker: Hugo Toras
273.text: "A political marriage is not about 'getting along'. Just ask Rita, if you can drag her out of the casinos."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "Will it get House Toras back on my side, even after everything I did?"

275.speaker: Hugo Toras
275.text: "It was indeed rather disastrous. But not through any fault of theirs."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "After the mess Rico's made of Iza, you still want Vina to marry him?"

277.speaker: Hugo Toras
277.text: "They'll forgive any number of transgressions if they know a Toras heir is forthcoming."

278.speaker: Hugo Toras
278.text: "He had Iza under control. Your decision to hand Duchess Azaro command of the police unit there complicated the situation."

286.speaker: Hugo Toras
286.text: "Like the extrajudicial capabilities of the Golden Guard."

287.speaker: Hugo Toras
287.text: "Like the extralegal talents of Su Omina."

290.speaker: Hugo Toras
290.text: "I would only suggest such a thing in extreme circumstances. Of which, I would argue, this is one."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "Sounds ghastly. But if there's no other way out of this..."

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "Excellent advice. See, this is what I keep you around for."

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "It means a lot to know you're on my side, even if the rest of our house is not."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "I don't want you to 'spin' anything. Our relatives will accept this pairing even if I have to cram it down their throats."

301.speaker: Hugo Toras
301.text: "I think you know what I'm referring to. Or more accurately, whom."

303.speaker: Hugo Toras
303.text: "I would not be saying this if it weren't true."

304.speaker: Hugo Toras
304.text: "The RNC's reclamation of seats in the House of Delegates was an extremely positive development."

311.speaker: Hugo Toras
311.text: "Your favorable tax policies have helped Valenqiris landowners flourish, even in the face of uncertainty."

315.speaker: Hugo Toras
315.text: "The traditionalists in our family were very satisfied with your further enshrinement of Wruhecism in Rizian law."
315.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_TaxSubsidyOne_Valenqiris"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true)

316.speaker: Hugo Toras
316.text: "Of course, the investment you have made in our home province has been greatly appreciated."
316.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_TaxSubsidyOne_Valenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EsqirisGasFieldExpansion_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Completed"] == true)

318.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
