329.text: "Our house is throwing its full support behind the rescue of your daughter. Had you betrayed Toras values, that might not be the case."

330.speaker: Hugo Toras
330.text: "Our house is ready and willing to support Rizia on the battlefield. Had you betrayed Toras values, that might not be the case."

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "Is that why you summoned me here? To tell me what a good job I've done?"
332.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_TaxSubsidyOne_Valenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EsqirisGasFieldExpansion_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false)

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Even if I hadn't done all that, they'd have to like me. I'm the king and the house heir."
334.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RNCWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_TaxSubsidyOne_Valenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EsqirisGasFieldExpansion_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false)

335.speaker: Hugo Toras
335.text: "I am loath to remind you, but there are those in House Toras who believe my brother, and hence you, should have been removed from the royal line of succession after introducing commoner blood."

336.speaker: Hugo Toras
336.text: "Fortunately, they have not spoken out since you took the throne."

337.speaker: Hugo Toras
337.text: "But there is something that could cause you to lose our house entirely. Or rather -- someone."

341.speaker: Hugo Toras
341.text: "And the last thing you want to do is lose the popularity you've gained with House Toras."

342.speaker: Hugo Toras
342.text: "Forgive me. But as you know, whom the Princess weds affects us all."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "I don't need House Toras' favor that badly."

347.speaker: Hugo Toras
347.text: "It's not about our favor. It's about our legacy."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Absolutely not. No king should be above the law."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "I might well go that route in another situation. But not to get rid of Manus Sazon."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I admit I'm not comfortable with the extra-legal aspect of it all."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Hugo. How could you be so cold?"

352.speaker: Narrator
352.text: A log in the fireplace snapped, startling both of us.

354.speaker: Hugo Toras
354.text: "You cannot fathom the depths of my love for this family."

355.speaker: Hugo Toras
355.text: "Even during the nadir of your father's popularity, when the populace was clamoring for me to seize the throne... I stood by my brother's side."

356.speaker: Hugo Toras
356.text: "I am here to serve, Your Majesty."

357.speaker: Hugo Toras
357.text: "On the contrary. A sovereign, by virtue of his absolute authority and divine right, is the source from which all laws flow, not subject to them."

358.speaker: Hugo Toras
358.text: "A sovereign, by virtue of his absolute authority and divine right, is the source from which all laws flow, not subject to them."

360.speaker: Hugo Toras
360.text: "I will leave it up to you. Perhaps a good talking-to could scare him off just as easily."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "I like carrots. They're full of vitamins."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "If talking to him doesn't work, can I just, you know, dispose of him?"

363.speaker: Hugo Toras
363.text: "Of course. I was hesitant to bring up that option because I thought you were fond of him."

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "I'd rather go straight for the stick. King Romus bends over backwards for nobody."

368.speaker: Hugo Toras
368.text: "By all means, make him an offer."

370.speaker: Hugo Toras
370.text: "Perhaps with an expanded Golden Guard... but it's too late now. I suggest you give him a good talking-to."

371.speaker: Hugo Toras
371.text: "However, this doesn't solve the problem of whom the Princess should wed."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "I'll hazard a guess. You think the lucky groom should be Rico."

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: Bruno's ears perked up at the mention of his former master's name.

378.speaker: Hugo Toras
378.text: "There is a reason my son has not yet married, yes."

379.speaker: Hugo Toras
379.text: "A royal union between two Torases will secure the future of our house beyond a shadow of a doubt."

380.speaker: Player_Romus
380.text: "It'll also produce a child with hooves."

381.speaker: Hugo Toras
381.text: "That's a myth. Need I remind you that I myself was the product of an inter-house marriage?"

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "I have half a mind to marry her to Axel Reinhart."

386.speaker: Narrator
386.text: Hugo drew his breath in through his teeth.

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "I don't want her to marry Manus. That doesn't mean I'm going to force her into a marriage with someone else."

388.speaker: Player_Romus
388.text: "You've got enough to worry about. Trust me, I will handle this."

390.speaker: Hugo Toras
390.text: "I never said you should force her. That would be horrific."

391.speaker: Hugo Toras
391.text: "But you can convince her to enter a political union for the good of the country. As your father convinced you."

393.speaker: Hugo Toras
393.text: "We came dangerously close to war with Pales. I would not trust the Duke with your daughter just yet."

397.speaker: Hugo Toras
397.text: "I know you are pursuing peace with Pales. But I am still not convinced Duke Reinhart shares your agenda."

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: "I trust him. He has treated her well the entire time she has been over there."

405.speaker: Hugo Toras
405.text: "He had Iza under control. Your withdrawal of the police unit you'd transferred there complicated the situation."

406.speaker: Hugo Toras
406.text: "I will always support you, my nephew. Do not doubt my loyalty."

407.speaker: Hugo Toras
407.text: "I recall my mother saying something similar. Almost verbatim, in fact."

413.speaker: Hugo Toras
413.text: "He has Iza under control. You'll see."
413.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_IzaLucitaHeadCentralPolice"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_IzaWithdrawCentralPolice"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_Iza_GiveRicoPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_Iza_SendCentralPolice"] == true)

414.speaker: Hugo Toras
414.text: "He did the best he could given his lack of support from the Crown."
414.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_IzaLucitaHeadCentralPolice"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_IzaWithdrawCentralPolice"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_Iza_GiveRicoPolice"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_Iza_SendCentralPolice"] == true) == false)

416.speaker: Hugo Toras
416.text: "I do not want to worry you. But at this point, pairing Vina and Rico may be the only way to prevent key members of our house from switching allegiances."

417.speaker: Hugo Toras
417.text: "This would be the ultimate show of loyalty to House Toras. I can't think of anything that would make our relations more grateful."

418.speaker: Hugo Toras
418.text: "Short of producing a male heir yourself."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "Think about it. It's the ultimate gesture of Rizian-Palesian unification."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "Reinhart's a nice guy. Now that we've gotten over our misunderstandings."

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "Don't you see? Having Reinhart as a son-in-law is the only surefire way to get him under my thumb."

423.speaker: Hugo Toras
423.text: "Or yet another opportunity for a Palesian power grab."

424.speaker: Hugo Toras
424.text: "Give him what he wants, and see if he remains 'nice'."

425.speaker: Hugo Toras
425.text: "Until you die, and the Reinharts take the Rizian throne."

426.speaker: Hugo Toras
426.text: "Because he knew he would face Rizian retaliation if he did not."

430.speaker: Hugo Toras
430.text: "I do not want to worry you. But name the wrong man as Prince Consort, and we may no longer be able to prevent key members of our house from switching allegiances."

431.speaker: Hugo Toras
431.text: "As I said, you have earned House Toras' loyalty. But name the wrong man as Prince Consort, and you run the risk of losing it."

433.speaker: Hugo Toras
433.text: "Well, unless you can produce a male heir yourself."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "I suppose she can always see other people on the side..."

441.speaker: Hugo Toras
441.text: "As long as the so-called free press never finds out about it."

445.speaker: Hugo Toras
445.text: "As long as you continue to keep a lid on the press."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "I made a promise to her. I'd be a bad father if I didn't keep it."

447.speaker: Hugo Toras
447.text: "It was rash of you to make that promise in the first place."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "For the good of the country? Or for our own house's gain?"

449.speaker: Player_Romus
449.text: "I always hated him for that. I don't want Vina feeling that way about me."

450.speaker: Hugo Toras
450.text: "The most profound acts of love for one's family often go unreciprocated."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Father did know better than I knew myself at the time."

452.speaker: Hugo Toras
452.text: "We hold the throne. What is good for us is good for the entire kingdom."

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "You would have made a lousy king, anyway."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "I know. I apologize. Thank you for your loyalty."

468.speaker: Narrator
468.text: I saw pain in his eyes.

470.speaker: Hugo Toras
470.text: "Regarding the Sazon situation, I will leave it up to you. Perhaps a good talking-to would be just as effective."

471.speaker: Hugo Toras
471.text: "I shouldn't be harping on about this with the Princess facing such an uncertain fate. The war deserves your full attention."

475.speaker: Hugo Toras
475.text: "I should stop harping on about this. The war deserves your full attention."
475.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

479.speaker: Hugo Toras
479.text: "I should stop harping on about this. I know you and the Princess will make the right decision."
479.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

480.speaker: Player_Romus
480.text: "Indeed it does. I should be going now."

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "No, thank you for bringing this up. You've given me a lot to think about."

483.speaker: Hugo Toras
483.text: "I am sorry to harp on about this with the Princess facing such an uncertain fate. The war deserves your full attention."

487.speaker: Hugo Toras
487.text: "I am sorry to harp on about this. The war deserves your full attention."
487.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

491.speaker: Hugo Toras
491.text: "I am sorry to harp on about this when your mind has clearly been made up."
491.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Yes, please stop harping. I know the tune by heart already."

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "You're my Grand Vizier and my uncle. Your advice is always valuable to me."

498.speaker: Narrator
498.text: Bruno sat up and licked Hugo's hand hopefully. My uncle gave the dog a single pat on the head.

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "He is the King's dog. Why shouldn't he be treated like royalty?"

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "I shot his leg off. He gets whatever he wants."

503.speaker: Narrator
503.text: The fire began to flicker out as Hugo ushered me out the door.

504.speaker: Narrator
504.text: Titus shadowed me down the hall as I made my way back towards my quarters.

505.speaker: Narrator
505.text: On the way there, we passed my study door.

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "Come in for a second, Titus. I want to speak to you privately."

509.speaker: Narrator
509.text: I asked the palace operator to give me a private line to Manus Sazon. After a few rings, he answered.

510.speaker: Manus Sazon
510.text: "{RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. To what do I owe this pleasure?"

511.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
511.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Titus"] == true) == false

512.speaker: Player_Romus
512.text: "What would it take for you to go on a permanent vacation?"

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "The time has come for you to do your patriotic duty. I am sending you to lead your province's battalion in Pales."
513.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false

514.speaker: Narrator
514.text: I asked the palace operator to give me a private line to Rico Toras. After a few rings, my cousin picked up.

520.speaker: Player_Romus
520.text: "What business is it of yours? You gave him away."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "Would you like to talk to him?"

523.speaker: Rico Toras
523.text: "No, that's ridiculous. But give him greetings from Bella."

524.speaker: Rico Toras
524.text: "You're right, Your Majesty. Sorry I asked."

525.speaker: Rico Toras
525.text: "Ha. He's a stone-cold killer. No amount of pampering will soften him."

526.speaker: Rico Toras
526.text: "Anyway. Is there something I can do for you?"

527.speaker: Rico Toras
527.text: "Is there something I can do for you?"

529.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
529.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

530.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
530.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false) == false

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: "I require the assistance of your friends in Su Omina."
531.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

532.speaker: Narrator
532.text: The line was quiet for a moment.

533.speaker: Manus Sazon
533.text: "I'm not sure what you're getting at."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "I just had an uncomfortable talk with my uncle. My house is pressuring me to dispose of you."

538.speaker: Player_Romus
538.text: "Such as ordering him to fight in Pales?"

539.speaker: Hugo Toras
539.text: "A most elegant solution. I doubt he's much of a fighter, but his charisma will work wonders on the Brenas troops."

540.speaker: Player_Romus
540.text: "If he doesn't make it back alive, Vina will never forgive me."

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "And if he comes back a war hero?"

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "If anyone can rescue Vina, he can."

547.speaker: Hugo Toras
547.text: "By then, ideally, the Princess will have been claimed by another suitor."

548.speaker: Player_Romus
548.text: "His Rizian charisma... his charizzma, if you will. Or should we just call it 'rizz'?"

551.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
551.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false

552.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
552.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == false) == false

553.speaker: Narrator
553.text: The line was quiet for a moment.

555.speaker: Manus Sazon
555.text: "I am honored, of course. But I have no military training."

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "I've seen what an inspiring leader you can be. Your province's troops need you."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "You're the only one I trust to rescue my daughter."

561.speaker: Player_Romus
561.text: "With today's technology, you don't need training. You just need to be able to push buttons."

562.speaker: Player_Romus
562.text: "You've displayed admirable strategic skills. Both in the House of Delegates, and in courting my daughter."

567.speaker: Manus Sazon
567.text: "I must warn you that if I leave the House of Delegates, it will jeopardize our chances of reform."

569.speaker: Manus Sazon
569.text: "I feel I can aid our cause much more capably in Porte Drazon than on the battlefield."

570.speaker: Player_Romus
570.text: "You claim to speak for the people. But how will it look if you let your province send commoners to die while refusing to go to war yourself?"

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "You are going to Pales, Mr. Sazon. That's a royal order."

572.speaker: Manus Sazon
572.text: "I am worried sick about Her Highness as well. And yet..."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "All right. If you'd rather leave Vina to rot in a dungeon, you don't have to go."

577.speaker: Player_Romus
577.text: "All right. If you insist on betraying your country as your father did before you, you don't have to go."

578.speaker: Player_Romus
578.text: "Perhaps you have a point. Stay, then. But I expect you to make yourself indispensable to me."

579.speaker: Narrator
579.text: He let out a long exhale.

580.speaker: Manus Sazon
580.text: "You are right, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. I should not presume myself to be above this country's conscription laws."

581.speaker: Narrator
581.text: There was a slight tremor in his voice as he replied.

582.speaker: Manus Sazon
582.text: "I will do as you ask, Your Majesty."

586.speaker: Manus Sazon
586.text: "And I will do everything I can to bring the Princess home safe and sound."

588.speaker: Narrator
588.text: He let out a long exhale.

589.speaker: Manus Sazon
589.text: "I would not dare to disobey my king. I will go to Pales."

590.speaker: Narrator
590.text: He let out a long exhale.

591.speaker: Manus Sazon
591.text: "Most certainly. I and the RPP will not fail you during this time of crisis."

595.speaker: Manus Sazon
595.text: "And I will do everything I can to lead Rizia to victory."

596.speaker: Manus Sazon
596.text: "I have one suggestion. My absence will leave a power vacuum in House Sazon."

597.speaker: Manus Sazon
597.text: "If you want to keep working with us, I recommend you end the exile of my mother. Bring her back to Rizia."

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "There are people out there who want you killed. It's dangerous for you to stay in the country."

600.speaker: Manus Sazon
600.text: "We were just starting to build momentum after our election gains. Removing me as majority leader could set us back years."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "Who cares about reforms when we have a war to win?"

605.speaker: Manus Sazon
605.text: "The RPP is already losing Delegate seats. Removing me as opposition leader could shrink our numbers beyond recovery."

606.speaker: Manus Sazon
606.text: "We must not overlook our country's internal welfare, even during times of war. Otherwise, what are our soldiers even fighting for?"

607.speaker: Manus Sazon
607.text: "Reforms are no less important during wartime. In fact, they're especially crucial."

608.speaker: Manus Sazon
608.text: "You have to ask yourself, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. What kind of country are we fighting for?"

609.speaker: Player_Romus
609.text: "One battle at a time, Mr. Sazon. When you return victorious from Pales, we will turn back to our reforms."

610.speaker: Player_Romus
610.text: "I am fighting to restore our kingdom's former borders. And so are you."

611.speaker: Player_Romus
611.text: "I understand what you're saying. Stay in the capital, then, and keep your nose to the grindstone."

614.speaker: Manus Sazon
614.text: "I understand. I will do as you command."

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "I changed my mind about you and Vina. I want the two of you as far away from each other as possible."

622.speaker: Player_Romus
622.text: "You and Vina shouldn't be around each other. Too much temptation."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "You've got friends in Kyrute, right? What if you were to just go back there?"

624.speaker: Manus Sazon
624.text: "I appreciate your concern for my safety."

625.speaker: Manus Sazon
625.text: "But I've had a target on my back since the day I was born. I found it's best not to live in fear."

626.speaker: Manus Sazon
626.text: "I'm sorry? You made your approval quite clear on the Rizania."

627.speaker: Player_Romus
627.text: "Read the writing on the wall, son. Rizia has no use for you anymore. You need to get out while you still can."

628.speaker: Manus Sazon
628.text: "You made your feelings about us quite clear on the Rizania. We would never disrespect your wishes."

629.speaker: Manus Sazon
629.text: "I can't do that. My duty is to my house, my party and my country."

633.speaker: Manus Sazon
633.text: "I can't do that. Not now that my party has finally gained a majority in the House of Delegates."

634.speaker: Player_Romus
634.text: "If you do, your combat fatigues await."

636.speaker: Player_Romus
636.text: "I still don't want you anywhere near Vina."
636.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

638.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
638.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

639.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
639.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

640.speaker: Player_Romus
640.text: "I don't want you failing my daughter, either."
640.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

644.speaker: Manus Sazon
644.text: "Yes, you made yourself quite clear about that."

645.speaker: Narrator
645.text: I put down the receiver and looked at the phone.

646.speaker: Player_Romus
646.text: "Angelica has more than served her sentence. Perhaps it's indeed time to bring her home."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "She's a disgraced noble, not a politician."

648.speaker: Manus Sazon
648.text: "Her legacy looms large in Brenas. If any Sazon can command a larger following than I can..."

649.speaker: Manus Sazon
649.text: "It's been almost 30 years. She has had plenty of time to regret her role in the uprising."

650.speaker: Manus Sazon
650.text: "It's been almost 30 years. She has spent more of her life on Caleqabiz than in her home province."

655.speaker: Player_Romus
655.text: "Say farewell to Vina tonight. I want you in Pales as soon as possible."
655.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false)

657.speaker: Player_Romus
657.text: "Whatever happens, I know you will make your province proud."

658.speaker: Player_Romus
658.text: "I wish you strength and luck on your perilous mission."

659.speaker: Manus Sazon
659.text: "And I wish you the same in steering the country through this tough time."

661.speaker: Manus Sazon
661.text: "Oh-- of course. We will speak upon my return, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "You must have read the rumors about her and Axel Reinhart. Who knows what she got up to over there?"

663.speaker: Player_Romus
663.text: "I'll put it this way. If you agree to leave Rizia and break off all contact with Vina, I will make it worth your while."

667.speaker: Narrator
667.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

668.speaker: Narrator
668.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

673.speaker: Manus Sazon
673.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think there is anything in this world that's more valuable to me than Vina, I..."

675.speaker: Manus Sazon
675.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think there is anything in this world that would make me abandon Rizia, I..."

677.speaker: Manus Sazon
677.text: "Angelica Sazon has been imprisoned on Caleqabiz for nearly 30 years. Bring her back to Iza, and I will take my leave."

681.speaker: Manus Sazon
681.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think you can intimidate me into abandoning Vina, I..."

682.speaker: Manus Sazon
682.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think you can intimidate me into abandoning Rizia, I..."

684.speaker: Manus Sazon
684.text: "Well. There is one request that, if granted, might change my mind."

685.speaker: Manus Sazon
685.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think such patently untrue allegations can convince me to abandon Vina, I..."

687.speaker: Manus Sazon
687.text: "Well. There is one way I could be convinced to honor your request."

688.speaker: Manus Sazon
688.text: "She is more than happy with the direction in which you've taken Rizia."

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "Never. She'll die on that island for what she did."

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "Your mother has more than served her sentence. Perhaps it's indeed time to bring her home."

691.speaker: Player_Romus
691.text: "And what do you expect her to do there?"

693.speaker: Manus Sazon
693.text: "What *did* she do? It's never been proven she had a hand in my father's crimes."

694.speaker: Manus Sazon
694.text: "She has spent more of her life on Caleqabiz than in her home province. It would mean so much to her if she were to touch the soil of Brenas again."

698.speaker: Manus Sazon
698.text: "Like the other Sazons, she is worried about the direction in which you are taking Rizia."

699.speaker: Manus Sazon
699.text: "But freeing her is a major step towards bringing my family back around to your side."

700.speaker: Hugo Toras
700.text: "We've done nothing but talk shop lately, haven't we? Perhaps once Rizia wins the war, Rita and I can have you over for a proper dinner."

704.speaker: Hugo Toras
704.text: "We've done nothing but talk shop lately, haven't we? Perhaps once things have calmed down, Rita and I can have you over for a proper dinner."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "Dinner will be on me. In Pales."

706.speaker: Player_Romus
706.text: "Sure. But I doubt things will ever calm down."

710.speaker: Player_Romus
710.text: "Only if we shoot the entree ourselves."

712.speaker: Player_Romus
712.text: "I'd love that. If my schedule allows."

713.speaker: Player_Romus
713.text: "That depends. Has she stopped nagging you to retire?"

715.speaker: Hugo Toras
715.text: "Family is family, Romus. We love them even when we hate them."

716.speaker: Player_Romus
716.text: "No, nothing. Just making sure you pick up the phone when your king calls you."

717.speaker: Narrator
717.text: Bruno turned around a few times, then splayed himself out on the carpet in front of me.

718.speaker: Rico Toras
718.text: "That depends. What kind of assistance do you need?"

722.speaker: Rico Toras
722.text: "They're already hard at work sowing chaos in Zille. What else would you ask?"

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "The Sazon heir is a danger to our house. I need him gone."

724.speaker: Player_Romus
724.text: "You know how you weren't involved in the Zille bombing? I want you to be 'uninvolved' in the disappearance of Manus Sazon."

725.speaker: Player_Romus
725.text: "I changed my mind. They're already doing enough."

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "Sorry, the idiot operator connected me to you accidentally."

730.speaker: Player_Romus
730.text: "You're a politician. You know that sometimes, we have to sacrifice our individual desires on the altar of the greater good."

731.speaker: Player_Romus
731.text: "House Toras has deemed you a threat. And I take my family's concerns seriously."

732.speaker: Narrator
732.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

736.speaker: Manus Sazon
736.text: "Is this about Vina? I assure you I'd never disrespect your wishes."

737.speaker: Manus Sazon
737.text: "And of course, I could never leave Her Highness."

738.speaker: Narrator
738.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

739.speaker: Manus Sazon
739.text: "What 'greater good' are you talking about, Your Majesty? If you really think I'd abandon everything I've worked so hard for..."

743.speaker: Player_Romus
743.text: "Do not make me repeat myself. I, King Romus of Rizia, would like you to leave the country."

744.speaker: Manus Sazon
744.text: "This is the twentieth century, Your Majesty. If you really think I'd let familial infighting interfere with my political obligations, I..."

745.speaker: Manus Sazon
745.text: "And if you want to keep my house's favor, her return will be crucial."

746.speaker: Player_Romus
746.text: "If we agree on this, I don't just want you to leave. I want you to break Vina's heart."

747.speaker: Player_Romus
747.text: "And her own leanings? Is she as radical as you are?"

751.speaker: Player_Romus
751.text: "Your love for your mother is touching. How about this, then: you leave Rizia, and I'll leave her alive."

752.speaker: Player_Romus
752.text: "Do you take me for a fool? That's like releasing a tarantula to take care of a gnat problem."

753.speaker: Manus Sazon
753.text: "It's the only practical choice, to be honest."

755.speaker: Manus Sazon
755.text: "Your Majesty... you wouldn't execute the matriarch of the Sazon family without reason. Especially while we're at war."

759.speaker: Manus Sazon
759.text: "For a chance to bring my mother back home... I will."

760.speaker: Manus Sazon
760.text: "She speaks of her participation in the uprising with nothing but regret."

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "And her own politics? Is she as hungry for change as you or I?"

768.speaker: Player_Romus
768.text: "My house will depose me, Manus. If that happens, everything we've been working towards will evaporate."

769.speaker: Narrator
769.text: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

770.speaker: Manus Sazon
770.text: "Your Majesty, if you really think I'd leave the country just to keep you on the throne, I..."

771.speaker: Narrator
771.text: A long moment passed in silence.

772.speaker: Player_Romus
772.text: "So you love your mother more than my daughter."

776.speaker: Player_Romus
776.text: "This was your plan all along, wasn't it? Springing your mother from prison?"

778.speaker: Manus Sazon
778.text: "But if this is my only chance to end my mother's exile... I have to take it."

779.speaker: Manus Sazon
779.text: "Not at all. I thought she was doomed to waste away on Caleqabiz."

780.speaker: Manus Sazon
780.text: "If this is my only chance to end her exile... I have to take it."

781.speaker: Player_Romus
781.text: "It's a deal, then. You will leave Rizia, and Angelica Sazon will return."

782.speaker: Player_Romus
782.text: "Never mind any of this. Freeing your mother is too high a price to pay."

783.speaker: Manus Sazon
783.text: "If that's the way it must be. Just give me a few days to get my affairs in order."

787.speaker: Manus Sazon
787.text: "If Vina makes it back, tell her I'm sorry."

788.speaker: Manus Sazon
788.text: "And figure out what to say to Vina."
788.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)

792.speaker: Manus Sazon
792.text: "I thought that might be the case."

796.speaker: Manus Sazon
796.text: "Don't worry. I won't tell Vina we had this conversation."

797.speaker: Manus Sazon
797.text: "Don't worry. I won't tell anyone else we had this conversation."

798.speaker: Manus Sazon
798.text: "Your Majesty, you wouldn't execute the matriarch of the Sazon family without reason."

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "Who said I don't have a reason? She could be orchestrating another uprising from exile."

800.speaker: Player_Romus
800.text: "I wouldn't. But we're at war. Bombs get dropped in all kinds of places. Like Caleqabiz."

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "She should have been executed before you were born. I'd just be handling my father's unfinished business. As usual."

808.speaker: Manus Sazon
808.text: "Then what do you want, Your Majesty? Just tell me."

809.speaker: Player_Romus
809.text: "I will go with your suggestion. You will leave Rizia, and Angelica Sazon will return."

813.speaker: Player_Romus
813.text: "Don't tell her a damn thing. Just go."

814.speaker: Player_Romus
814.text: "You'll come up with something, I'm sure."

816.speaker: Player_Romus
816.text: "I won't tell her a damn thing. That's part of the deal."

819.speaker: Player_Romus
819.text: "Say what you want. The press won't print it."

824.speaker: Player_Romus
824.text: "You'd better not, or I'll tell her what a mama's boy you are."

825.speaker: Player_Romus
825.text: "Screw this. I'm not giving in to my uncle. Stay in Rizia, and I'll find a way to bring Angelica Sazon home."

830.speaker: Manus Sazon
830.text: "Your Majesty, you would have my house's eternal gratitude."

832.speaker: Player_Romus
832.text: "It hasn't been done. Don't thank me yet."

838.speaker: Player_Romus
838.text: "Don't tell Vina I tried to get rid of you, though."

841.speaker: Manus Sazon
841.text: "I will help you in any way that I can."

844.speaker: Manus Sazon
844.text: "Should I be surprised? I was practically born with a target drawn on me."

845.speaker: Narrator
845.text: The line was quiet for a moment.

846.speaker: Player_Romus
846.text: "My daughter, Vina. What do you think of her?"

847.speaker: Rico Toras
847.text: "She possesses all the beauty and grace one would expect of a royal scion, especially one from House Toras."

850.speaker: Player_Romus
850.text: "You just can't wait to get your hands on her, can you?"

854.speaker: Rico Toras
854.text: "I assume you've been talking to my father."

856.speaker: Rico Toras
856.text: "To tell you the truth, I wouldn't mind having one less Sazon around, either."

857.speaker: Rico Toras
857.text: "I'll ask our Porte Drazon chapter to arrange for his prompt... departure. They can sprinkle some evidence of treason to the Crown while they're at it."

859.speaker: Player_Romus
859.text: "Can those treasonous plans include seducing the King's daughter?"

863.speaker: Rico Toras
863.text: "I'm happy to help out a friend of the movement."

864.speaker: Rico Toras
864.text: "I should say so. They've had their work cut out for them lately."

868.speaker: Rico Toras
868.text: "You're too modest. Your policies have done more than they ever could."

870.speaker: Narrator
870.text: Titus, Bruno and I entered the study. I shut the door behind us.

874.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
874.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Titus"] == true) == false

875.speaker: Player_Romus
875.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Titus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_Adopted"] == true)

879.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
879.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_PhoneCalls_Titus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_Adopted"] == true) == false)

880.speaker: Narrator
880.text: Bruno followed me out of the study.

884.speaker: Rico Toras
884.text: "I'm glad you finally came around to the movement."

885.speaker: Rico Toras
885.text: "I already told you Su Omina wasn't responsible. You've literally had years to find evidence against them."

886.speaker: Rico Toras
886.text: "But to tell you the truth, I wouldn't mind having one less Sazon around either."

889.speaker: Narrator
889.text: I could hear him thinking it over.

890.speaker: Player_Romus
890.text: "A political union may be in the works. But I'm warning you, you are not to lay so much as a finger on Vina without her consent."

891.speaker: Player_Romus
891.text: "This isn't a trap, Rico. Do you genuinely want to marry her?"

892.speaker: Rico Toras
892.text: "What I want is to keep Rizia from going to hell. If I have to marry the Princess to do that, I will."

893.speaker: Player_Romus
893.text: "I have. I don't believe the future of our kingdom should hinge on a marriage between cousins."

898.speaker: Player_Romus
898.text: "Hugo has nothing to do with it. The Lord has ordained that House Toras shall keep the throne for millennia to come."

899.speaker: Rico Toras
899.text: "I have... needs... that certain women in certain establishments in Iza and Porte Drazon are already well trained to fulfill."

900.speaker: Rico Toras
900.text: "Halaita. If it is said, so it will be."

901.speaker: Rico Toras
901.text: "No Sazon is going to uproot this family tree."

904.speaker: Rico Toras
904.text: "Aside from the obligation to produce an heir, I expect the Princess and I would go about our lives much as we have been."

905.speaker: Rico Toras
905.text: "You have a lot of plans for the future of our kingdom, don't you? None of which seem to involve actual Rizians."

909.speaker: Rico Toras
909.text: "As long as Rizia still belongs to Rizians, we'll survive."

913.speaker: Rico Toras
913.text: "We won't let the other houses uproot this family tree."

915.speaker: Player_Romus
915.text: "I'm happy you see it that way as well."

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "I did not ask for that much information."

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "Well, that's good to know. Thank you for your honesty."

919.speaker: Rico Toras
919.text: "Thank you for the phone call, Your Majesty. Expect a prompt resolution of the Sazon situation."

920.speaker: Rico Toras
920.text: "I didn't want you to think I was lying."

924.speaker: Rico Toras
924.text: "Thank you for the phone call, Your Majesty."

925.speaker: Player_Romus
925.text: "We will grow straight and proud, until we reach the stars."

926.speaker: Player_Romus
926.text: "It's not the other houses I'm worried about."

929.speaker: Player_Romus
929.text: "In the end, it's the Rizian bloodline that matters. Not any individual house."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "That depends on your definition of 'actual Rizians'."

931.speaker: Player_Romus
931.text: "Do not talk back to your king. My policies are not to be disputed."

932.speaker: Player_Romus
932.text: "Giving foreigners more rights won't endanger those of us who were born here."

933.speaker: Rico Toras
933.text: "No. Because we will fight to the death against being replaced."

934.speaker: Rico Toras
934.text: "Not by me alone. But there are others who feel this way."

935.speaker: Rico Toras
935.text: "Those of us with strong, deep, ties to  this land."

936.speaker: Rico Toras
936.text: "I think you'll find we will not be so easily uprooted."

942.speaker: Rico Toras
942.text: "I -- we -- will hold you to it."

943.speaker: Narrator
943.text: There was a click as he hung up.

952.speaker: Narrator
952.text: Titus and I entered the study. I shut the door behind us.

953.speaker: Narrator
953.text: Titus cautiously entered the study and shut the door behind him.

955.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
955.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

956.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
956.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false) == false

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "I need the Golden Guard to deal with Manus Sazon."
957.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

965.speaker: Rico Toras
965.text: "After everything you've done for me and this country, I owe you immensely."

969.speaker: Rico Toras
969.text: "Even if I've disagreed with some of the changes you've made to our kingdom, I owe you for helping me bring order to my little corner of it."
969.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_TreatmentOfForeigners_Unfair"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true)

970.speaker: Rico Toras
970.text: "You're my blood kin and the monarch of this kingdom. I will serve you for as long as you hold the throne."
970.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_TreatmentOfForeigners_Unfair"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_RicoControlsPolice"] == true) == false)

972.speaker: Player_Romus
972.text: "Please, my cousin. You owe me nothing."

973.speaker: Player_Romus
973.text: "And you'd never do anything to cut that time short... right?"

974.speaker: Player_Romus
974.text: "Careful not to abuse your power. Being my cousin doesn't make you immune from the law."

975.speaker: Player_Romus
975.text: "Serve well, and you will be rewarded for it."

980.speaker: Rico Toras
980.text: "Service to my family is its own reward."

989.speaker: Player_Romus
989.text: "I asked you to frame Rico ages ago. What the devil is going on?"

990.speaker: Titus Gordion
990.text: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. We've been wrapped up in the war."

994.speaker: Titus Gordion
994.text: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. It hasn't been easy to find a way into his palace."

995.speaker: Titus Gordion
995.text: "You and your cousin are both speaking at Iza University next month, are you not?"

996.speaker: Titus Gordion
996.text: "I'll send a few extra guards ahead. They'll take care of it while the Duke is occupied at the event."

997.speaker: Player_Romus
997.text: "They had damn well better. The clock is ticking."

998.speaker: Player_Romus
998.text: "Splendid. It's about time the kid learned a lesson."

999.speaker: Player_Romus
999.text: "It gives me no great pleasure to turn in my cousin. But for a reunited Rizia, it has to be done."

1000.speaker: Player_Romus
1000.text: "Remember how I asked you to plant evidence against my cousin? I changed my mind."

1002.speaker: Titus Gordion
1002.text: "I was going to tell my men to complete the task next month, while you're both speaking in Iza."

1003.speaker: Titus Gordion
1003.text: "But I have not yet given the orders."

1004.speaker: Player_Romus
1004.text: "Thank God. The kid could be useful to me yet."

1005.speaker: Player_Romus
1005.text: "You should have taken care of this months ago. But just as well. Call it off."

1006.speaker: Player_Romus
1006.text: "Well, if you've gone to all the trouble of planning it... I say do it."

1007.speaker: Titus Gordion
1007.text: "He is your cousin. Perhaps it's best to keep him close."

1008.speaker: Titus Gordion
1008.text: "Truly sorry. Our time has been limited since the war started."

1012.speaker: Titus Gordion
1012.text: "Truly sorry. It hasn't been easy to find a way into his palace."

1013.speaker: Titus Gordion
1013.text: "Yes, I'm aware. The Golden Guard will not fail you."

1014.speaker: Titus Gordion
1014.text: "I have no doubt that jailing him will be for the greater good."

1015.speaker: Titus Gordion
1015.text: "Not every king would be so brave."

1017.speaker: Titus Gordion
1017.text: "Should you choose to assign us a similar task in the future, we will get to it straight away."

1018.speaker: Titus Gordion
1018.text: "We will, Your Majesty. The Golden Guard won't fail you."

1021.speaker: Titus Gordion
1021.text: "You'd like us to launch an investigation into the young man?"

1022.speaker: Player_Romus
1022.text: "No. I need him arrested. Preferably tonight."

1023.speaker: Titus Gordion
1023.text: "I haven't forgotten about our other assignments. Rest assured we'll ferret out the truth soon."
1023.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_GoldenGuard_InvestigateSO"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == false)

1024.speaker: Player_Romus
1024.text: "I need him out of the picture. Completely. I don't care how you do it."

1025.speaker: Player_Romus
1025.text: "I need you to do to him what you're doing to Rico Toras. But faster."

1029.speaker: Titus Gordion
1029.text: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. We've been wrapped up in the war."

1033.speaker: Titus Gordion
1033.text: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. It hasn't been easy to find a way into the Duke's palace."

1034.speaker: Titus Gordion
1034.text: "We were planning on completing the task next month, while you're both speaking in Iza."

1035.speaker: Titus Gordion
1035.text: "Given Mr. Sazon's lack of guards and residence in Porte Drazon, targeting him with a similar operation would go much more swiftly."

1036.speaker: Player_Romus
1036.text: "Perfect. I want you to frame Manus as a traitor to the throne. But don't forget about your original assignment."

1037.speaker: Player_Romus
1037.text: "Actually, never mind Manus. Keep your focus on Rico."

1038.speaker: Player_Romus
1038.text: "Do it, then. But don't bother framing Rico. The kid could still be of use to me."

1039.speaker: Titus Gordion
1039.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. I'll tell my men to get right on it."

1040.speaker: Titus Gordion
1040.text: "Noted. I'll tell my men to switch their focus to the Sazon heir."

1044.speaker: Titus Gordion
1044.text: "Given his family's history, nobody would be surprised if evidence turned up connecting him to a plot against the throne."

1045.speaker: Player_Romus
1045.text: "A plot that requires him to earn the trust of the King's daughter."

1046.speaker: Player_Romus
1046.text: "Good thinking, Titus. What would I do without you?"

1048.speaker: Titus Gordion
1048.text: "Interesting. Yes, we can include that detail."

1049.speaker: Titus Gordion
1049.text: "You only need your council's approval to jail him. And I doubt they'll ask many questions."

1050.speaker: Titus Gordion
1050.text: "I am but an appendage of the Crown. I'm sure you would manage."

1051.speaker: Titus Gordion
1051.text: "Mr. Sazon lives in Porte Drazon without bodyguards. We can easily carry this out in the next few days."

1054.speaker: Rico Toras
1054.text: "See you in Iza next month? I hear we're both invited to speak at the university's anniversary."

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "Yes, I'm looking forward to it. As long as the students don't give us any trouble."

1056.speaker: Player_Romus
1056.text: "Don't remind me. I hate these kinds of engagements."

1057.speaker: Player_Romus
1057.text: "I expect the city to be in tip-top shape for my arrival."

1059.speaker: Rico Toras
1059.text: "Really? I find the spotlight so invigorating. Like a hot bath."

1060.speaker: Rico Toras
1060.text: "That's not up to me, I'm afraid."

1064.speaker: Player_Romus
1064.text: "Yes, I'm looking forward to it. All those bright young minds."

1065.speaker: Rico Toras
1065.text: "Bright, my foot. When I was their age I was leading rallies, not idling about in a classroom."

1070.speaker: Titus Gordion
1070.text: "I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologize that the investigation into your father's death is taking such a long time."

1071.speaker: Titus Gordion
1071.text: "I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologize that our investigation into the Wehlen bombing is taking such a long time."
1071.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_GoldenGuard_InvestigateSO"] == true)

1075.speaker: Titus Gordion
1075.text: "The war has been weighing on my mind, as I'm sure it has yours."

1079.speaker: Titus Gordion
1079.text: "The fate of Zille has been weighing on my mind, as I'm sure it has yours."

1081.speaker: Player_Romus
1081.text: "Fear not, Captain. The Lord will show us the way."

1085.speaker: Player_Romus
1085.text: "I've hardly been thinking about it at all."

1086.speaker: Titus Gordion
1086.text: "I wish all of Rizia shared your faith."

1087.speaker: Titus Gordion
1087.text: "I understand. It's only one of many problems you must attend to."

1088.speaker: Titus Gordion
1088.text: "You bear an unimaginable amount of responsibility. I do not envy you."

1089.speaker: Manus Sazon
1089.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true) == false)

1090.speaker: Manus Sazon
1090.text: "Never mind. It's best for her to stay out of this."

1091.speaker: Player_Romus
1091.text: "You should be scared. If I don't act, we might both lose our heads."

1092.speaker: Player_Romus
1092.text: "Yes, but now whatever affects you affects Vina. Please be careful."

1093.speaker: Player_Romus
1093.text: "I don't want to do as they're asking. But my reign as king depends on it."

1094.speaker: Manus Sazon
1094.text: "Your Majesty, I decided a long time ago that I would not live in fear. Whenever I die, that's my time."

1095.speaker: Player_Romus
1095.text: "This does not bode well for our reform plans. They'll be watching our every move."

1101.speaker: Manus Sazon
1101.text: "Pursuing a path of reform was always going to lose you support from House Toras. But the Sazons are prepared to protect you from the fallout."

1106.speaker: Manus Sazon
1106.text: "But that time doesn't have to be right now."

1110.speaker: Manus Sazon
1110.text: "As it stands, House Sazon will not protect you should you fall out of favor with your own family."

1112.speaker: Manus Sazon
1112.text: "However, there is one thing you can do that will earn you their -- our -- undying loyalty."

1113.speaker: Manus Sazon
1113.text: "Bring Angelica Sazon home. End my mother's exile."

1114.speaker: Manus Sazon
1114.text: "Still, if you want to be sure of their -- our -- loyalty, there is one thing you have yet to do."

1115.speaker: Player_Romus
1115.text: "Never. She'll die on that island for what she did."

1116.speaker: Player_Romus
1116.text: "She has more than served her sentence. Perhaps it's indeed time to bring her home."

1117.speaker: Player_Romus
1117.text: "If I did that, the rest of my house would turn its back on me forever."

1118.speaker: Manus Sazon
1118.text: "What *did* she do? It's never been proven she had a hand in my father's crimes."

1119.speaker: Manus Sazon
1119.text: "It's been almost 30 years. Half her life."

1121.speaker: Player_Romus
1121.text: "A canny suggestion. House Sazon will be considerably stronger with its matriarch back on the mainland."

1122.speaker: Manus Sazon
1122.text: "Stronger, and in great debt to you."

1123.speaker: Manus Sazon
1123.text: "Obviously, it is your decision. But if you share my goal of bringing true democracy to Rizia, I see no other choice."

1124.speaker: Player_Romus
1124.text: "No promises. But I'll see what I can do."

1125.speaker: Player_Romus
1125.text: "Your dedication to your mother is touching. I'd do the same if it were mine."

1126.speaker: Player_Romus
1126.text: "It's too high of a price to pay. She must carry out the sentence my father ordered her to serve."

1131.speaker: Manus Sazon
1131.text: "Obviously, it is your decision. But if you share my goal of bringing true democracy to Rizia, this will help us immensely."

1132.speaker: Manus Sazon
1132.text: "This is larger than just me. Bringing her back would bring hope to all of Brenas."

1139.speaker: Titus Gordion
1139.text: "I haven't forgotten about our other assignment. Rest assured we'll ferret out the truth soon."
1139.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_GoldenGuard_InvestigateSO"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == false) == false)

1140.speaker: Titus Gordion
1140.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_GoldenGuard_InvestigateSO"] == true) == false)

1141.speaker: Titus Gordion
1141.text: "Was that all you wanted to ask me?"

1142.speaker: Player_Romus
1142.text: "No. Hypothetically, how would you feel about an expansion of your duties?"

1143.speaker: Player_Romus
1143.text: "No, I wanted to ask how your special assignment was coming along. The one regarding my cousin Rico."

1145.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1145.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TitusChat_FrameManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

1146.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1146.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TitusChat_FrameManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false) == false

1147.speaker: Player_Romus
1147.text: "There's one more thing. I need the Golden Guard to deal with Manus Sazon."
1147.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TitusChat_FrameManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == false

1151.speaker: Player_Romus
1151.text: "No, I want you to cancel the operation to frame Rico."

1158.speaker: Player_Romus
1158.text: "We're both done here. You may escort me back to my chambers now."

1159.speaker: Player_Romus
1159.text: "Yes, you're dismissed. I'll be along in a minute."

1164.speaker: Narrator
1164.text: Titus and I left the study, with Bruno following close behind.

1165.speaker: Titus Gordion
1165.text: "I'll leave you to it, Your Majesty."

1166.speaker: Narrator
1166.text: With a bow and a salute, he left the room.

1168.speaker: Narrator
1168.text: Titus and I left the study and walked back to my chambers.

1169.speaker: Narrator
1169.text: Titus escorted us back to my chambers.

1170.speaker: Narrator
1170.text: Titus escorted me back to my chambers.

1171.speaker: Narrator
1171.text: My guard wished me goodnight before taking up his usual post outside my door.

1172.speaker: Narrator
1172.text: I knew my daughter would be heartbroken. I just hoped she would never find out I was the reason.
1172.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true

1173.text: With Bruno curled up next to me in bed, I thought about the order I'd just given.

1182.text: I knew my daughter would be heartbroken. I just hoped she would forgive me.

1183.text: I knew my uncle would be furious. I just hoped he would never find out the truth.

1187.speaker: Narrator
1187.text: With Bruno curled up next to me in bed, I thought about my conversation with my uncle.
1187.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_SleepsInBed"] == true)

1188.speaker: Narrator
1188.text: Who would carry on my name? And what would my legacy be?

1192.speaker: Narrator
1192.text: As I climbed into bed, I thought about the order I'd just given.
1192.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_SleepsInBed"] == true) == false)

1198.speaker: Manus Sazon
1198.text: "Thank you. You have no idea how much it would mean to my province."

1199.speaker: Manus Sazon
1199.text: "As long as you continue to favor House Sazon with your decrees, they  will still support us."

1203.speaker: Manus Sazon
1203.text: "It may not win over all of my house, but it is a big step in the right direction."

1207.speaker: Manus Sazon
1207.text: "And I guarantee it will get you the support you need from my house."

1208.speaker: Manus Sazon
1208.text: "Perhaps between my house and the Azaros, you can still get enough support to keep your hold on the crown."

1209.speaker: Player_Romus
1209.text: "If not, I guess I'll just have to kill you."

1213.speaker: Player_Romus
1213.text: "I'm a king. I shouldn't have to wheedle for approval like a love-starved puppy."

1217.speaker: Narrator
1217.text: Bruno nudged my foot with his nose.

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "For your sake, you'd better be right."

1222.speaker: Manus Sazon
1222.text: "A king is only king by the collective will of his subjects, Your Majesty."

1227.speaker: Manus Sazon
1227.text: "I should be going now. Thank you for your call."

1228.speaker: Player_Romus
1228.text: "Just wait till you and Vina get married. They won't be able to get enough of me."

1229.speaker: Manus Sazon
1229.text: "If Her Highness is rescued, you mean..."

1233.speaker: Narrator
1233.text: A sob lodged in his throat. He swallowed.

1234.speaker: Manus Sazon
1234.text: "I've been planning to ask her for some time."

1235.speaker: Narrator
1235.text: I heard excitement in his voice.

1236.speaker: Narrator
1236.text: We said our goodbyes and hung up.

1274.speaker: Titus Gordion
1274.text: "What do you mean, Your Majesty? The Golden Guard has already been expanded to its fullest extent."

1275.speaker: Titus Gordion
1275.text: "Are you finally considering an expansion of the Golden Guard, Your Majesty?"

1276.speaker: Narrator
1276.text: Titus immediately snapped to full attention.

1277.speaker: Player_Romus
1277.text: "There may be another opening. A rather higher-profile one."

1278.speaker: Player_Romus
1278.text: "How confident do you feel in matters of national security?"

1280.speaker: Titus Gordion
1280.text: "Extremely confident, sir. My experience commanding the Golden Guard has primed me to adapt to new threats and formulate creative strategies."

1281.speaker: Player_Romus
1281.text: "Where do your loyalties lie, Titus? To me or to the Kingdom of Rizia?"

1283.speaker: Titus Gordion
1283.text: "I am charged with protecting the King and his family. No matter what other responsibilities I am granted, your personal security will always come first."

1285.speaker: Titus Gordion
1285.text: "I am happy to take on any role for which you deem me suitable."

1286.speaker: Player_Romus
1286.text: "If an opportunity for advancement does arise and you are denied it. I hope you will not take it personally."

1293.speaker: Player_Romus
1293.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Valenqiris_EnvironmentCrisisIgnored"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_NaturalizationForForeigners"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_TenantProtectionLaws"] == true) == false)

1295.speaker: Hugo Toras
1295.text: "Believe me, I would love to. However..."

1299.speaker: Hugo Toras
1299.text: "You have been less than subtle about your reform intentions."

1303.speaker: Hugo Toras
1303.text: "Even going so far as to prohibit provincial leaders from shaping their own councils..."

1307.speaker: Hugo Toras
1307.text: "To the point where the anti-monarchist radicals of the Rizian People's Party now hold a parliament majority!"

1309.speaker: Hugo Toras
1309.text: "Romus, you must know that you cannot have it both ways. Valenqiris will only support your reforms if House Toras is assured some measure of continuity."

1322.speaker: Hugo Toras
1322.text: "But the expanded Golden Guard could handle precisely this eventuality."

1323.speaker: Hugo Toras
1323.text: "But your allies in Su Omina could handle it. Just bring it up with your cousin."

1324.speaker: Player_Romus
1324.text: "I will use neither carrot nor stick. I maintain that the Sazon heir is a useful ally."

1325.speaker: Narrator
1325.text: Hugo replied without a trace of anger in his voice.

1329.speaker: Player_Romus
1329.text: "Uncle. I am intent on reforming the country precisely because we cannot go on as before."

1330.speaker: Hugo Toras
1330.text: "Your Majesty, you must know that you cannot have it both ways. Valenqiris will only support your reforms if House Toras is assured some measure of continuity."

1331.speaker: Player_Romus
1331.text: "Your Grace, I am intent on reforming the country precisely because we cannot go on as before."

1332.speaker: Player_Romus
1332.text: "And they will get it. Our values and traditions will not disappear simply because the commoners have more of a say in politics."

1333.speaker: Player_Romus
1333.text: "These are cosmetic changes only, Hugo. The status of the nobility will not be harmed."

1334.speaker: Player_Romus
1334.text: "Your concern is duly noted. But I don't need Valenqiris' support."

1335.speaker: Hugo Toras
1335.text: "I wish I could believe you. But look at what you've already done."

1336.speaker: Hugo Toras
1336.text: "I don't think you've absorbed the gravity of the situation."

1337.speaker: Hugo Toras
1337.text: "You don't understand. Alienate House Toras and you, King Romus, will not go on at all."

1338.speaker: Player_Romus
1338.text: "I still have faith that we can change the country together, Mr. Sazon."

1343.speaker: Player_Romus
1343.text: "Perfect. I trust you to handle it at once."

1344.speaker: Player_Romus
1344.text: "On second thought, don't. I need your full focus on Rico."

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "On second thought, don't. He may still be of use to me."

1349.speaker: Player_Romus
1349.text: "No, no. If my daughter ever found out, she'd never look at me the same again."

1370.speaker: Player_Romus
1370.text: "Don't worry about it, Titus. You're in charge of my security, not the nation's."

1373.speaker: Player_Romus
1373.text: "I know you petitioned my father for the security councilor position. Why didn't you tell me?"

1374.speaker: Narrator
1374.text: My guard's breath caught in his throat.

1375.speaker: Titus Gordion
1375.text: "I was... embarrassed to have even made the request, Your Majesty. Obviously, I was neither as qualified nor suited as the heiress of House Azaro."

1376.speaker: Titus Gordion
1376.text: "After the events of the past several years, though, I would be proud to put my name forward."

1385.speaker: Player_Romus
1385.text: "Can I ask you something? What happened to you back in Derdia?"

1387.speaker: Titus Gordion
1387.text: "I must have been thrown off by the altitude. I'm sorry if my performance displeased you."

1389.speaker: Player_Romus
1389.text: "No worries. It happens to the best of us."

1390.speaker: Player_Romus
1390.text: "I watched the fight. He barely touched you. There's simply no way that blow was enough to make you collapse."

1393.speaker: Titus Gordion
1393.text: "It's an old boxing injury. Trauma to the kidney that I never fully recovered from."

1394.speaker: Titus Gordion
1394.text: "It flares up sometimes, especially when there's an impact to the wrong area. Rest assured that I never let it get in the way of my duties."

1395.speaker: Titus Gordion
1395.text: "I assure you, if we visit Derdia again, I will be better prepared for such an occasion."

1396.speaker: Player_Romus
1396.text: "I don't tolerate weakness in my guards, Titus."

1397.speaker: Player_Romus
1397.text: "Was your injury the reason why you left your post the night my father died?"

1398.speaker: Titus Gordion
1398.text: "I feel the same way. But I will take precautions to protect myself from such incidents in the future."

1399.speaker: Titus Gordion
1399.text: "Yes, I know. I hope you can forgive me."

1400.speaker: Narrator
1400.text: He stared at me with a mix of fear and shock.

1401.speaker: Titus Gordion
1401.text: "I've learned to manage it over the years."

1403.speaker: Player_Romus
1403.text: "Regardless, you should have told me about this liability of yours."

1404.speaker: Narrator
1404.text: A shadow of disappointment crossed his face.

1405.speaker: Titus Gordion
1405.text: "What happens in the kingdom as a whole greatly affects your personal security. I wouldn't be much of a guardsman if I didn't keep an ear to the ground."

1414.speaker: Titus Gordion
1414.text: "I... yes, Your Majesty. I was ashamed to admit my vulnerability earlier."

1416.speaker: Player_Romus
1416.text: "Before she was arrested, Lucita considered you a suspect in my father's possible murder."

1424.speaker: Player_Romus
1424.text: "It's possible my father was murdered. We're trying to get a full picture of what happened that night."

1427.speaker: Titus Gordion
1427.text: "That's rubbish. Considering what we now know about Duchess Azaro, I wouldn't trust a word of what she told you."

1428.speaker: Titus Gordion
1428.text: "I... yes. One of my men re-activated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier in the day."

1429.speaker: Titus Gordion
1429.text: "The pain became too much to bear, and I rushed to an unoccupied guest room to recuperate."

1431.speaker: Titus Gordion
1431.text: "But yes, you are right. One of my men reactivated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier that day."

1434.speaker: Titus Gordion
1434.text: "One of my men reactivated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier that day."

1435.speaker: Titus Gordion
1435.text: "I assigned one of my men to my post in my stead. When I returned, he reported no unusual activity."

1439.speaker: Titus Gordion
1439.text: "But I cannot help thinking I might have heard or noticed something he did not. At a moment when the King needed me most, I was not there."

1440.speaker: Titus Gordion
1440.text: "I know now that I failed the King in his moment of need."

1441.speaker: Titus Gordion
1441.text: "I will never let such a thing happen to me again, Your Majesty. I swear upon my life."

1445.speaker: Player_Romus
1445.text: "Make it up to me. Find proof of Lucita's guilt."

1449.speaker: Player_Romus
1449.text: "It isn't your fault. Your replacement allowed Lucita into the room, but I don't believe she killed my father."

1450.speaker: Player_Romus
1450.text: "You had better not. I need to be able to count on you. Titus."

1451.speaker: Player_Romus
1451.text: "You did everything right, Captain Gordion. Stop blaming yourself."

1452.speaker: Player_Romus
1452.text: "All right. Thank you for telling me the truth."

1454.speaker: Titus Gordion
1454.text: "Don't underestimate what that woman was capable of. Look what happened at the Pales border."

1458.speaker: Titus Gordion
1458.text: "I'm still focusing on our chosen subject. But don't underestimate what Duchess Azaro is capable of."

1461.speaker: Titus Gordion
1461.text: "Was there something else you wanted from me?"

1498.speaker: Player_Romus
1498.text: "Manus is not the problem. The entire House of Delegates must be dismantled."

1501.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

1505.speaker: Player_Romus
1505.text: "I could always ship him off to the frontline in Pales."

1506.speaker: Player_Romus
1506.text: "It sounds like you already have some ideas."

1508.speaker: Player_Romus
1508.text: "When is the last time you talked to her? Are you sure she still shares your views?"

1510.speaker: Manus Sazon
1510.text: "She speaks of her participation in the uprising with nothing but regret."

1511.speaker: Manus Sazon
1511.text: "But if she were to come to the mainland and witness our movement -- if she were to see that reform is possible without bloodshed -- I am sure she'd be on our side."

1514.speaker: Hugo Toras
1514.text: "I thought the same when your parents began seeing each other."

1515.speaker: Player_Romus
1515.text: "Don't worry. I'm not going to let Vina marry him."

1516.speaker: Hugo Toras
1516.text: "Then I suggest you present her with an alternative. The sooner, the better."
